thread:
maria_cs: Morning team — noticed overnight a set of EU onboarding imports (S3->index) failed for 7 high-touch trial accounts. Failures started ~02:14 UTC; the jobs retried but hit a 500 on the ingest lambda. I listed the tenants in the ticket.
kevin_eng: ack, investigating. Seeing NPEs in the transform when metadata.field_x missing. Will paste trimmed logs.
maria_cs: these are all in active trial/near-renewal. We should send a proactive customer note before the EU morning. Can eng confirm cause and ETA?
kevin_eng: root cause: last-night schema validation tightened and now rejects payloads missing metadata.field_x. Regression slipped through. Mitigation options: revert validation or coerce missing field to default. I can push a revert hotfix in ~45m.
lara_se: ill draft the comms for the 7 customers with a calm, helpful tone: acknowledgement, ETA, reassurance about data, and an offer for priority help + credits. Posting a template now.
maria_cs: add a 1:1 booking link and call out EU region specifically. Also confirm whether any partial writes/duplicates could have occurred.
kevin_eng: no partial writes. Failed jobs did not index; no data lost. Will include that reassurance in the note.
tom_cust: can we offer a 2-hour hands-on migration window? A few of these tenants go live next week.
lara_se: proposing Tue 14:00-16:00 CET office hours with priority booking. Draft: 
---
Hi {{first_name}} —
We wanted to let you know we hit an issue last night affecting your onboarding import to Redwood Inference. A recent schema validation change caused imports to fail with a server error.
What were doing: were rolling a hotfix to restore imports and will re-run your failed jobs shortly. Estimated restoration: ~45 minutes.
Data impact: no data was lost; failed jobs were blocked before indexing.
Next steps: well notify you when your import completes. If youd like hands-on help, book a priority enablement slot here: https://redwood.example.com/office-hours (EU slot available).
Compensation: were applying a one-time credit equal to the import job cost and offering a complimentary 60-minute migration session for the affected accounts.
If you prefer we do NOT re-run the job automatically, reply to this message and well pause and coordinate manual re-run.
Thanks for your patience,
Maria on behalf of Redwood Inference Support
---

maria_cs: change "60-minute" to "60-minute (high-touch)" for these accounts and call out the exact booking link.
lara_se: updated and added an opt-out note + reply-to scheduling email. Sending now.
ops_bot: Incident created INC-2026-345, on-call notified.
kevin_eng: hotfix deployed at 03:01 UTC (reverted strict validation). Re-triggering failed imports now.
kevin_eng: re-run started 03:07 UTC: 5/7 completed quickly, 2 queued due to rate caps; clearing backlog.
maria_cs: lara, please send the comms to all 7 and include opt-out instructions and the EU office-hours slot. Ill handle credits after verification.
lara_se: sent to all 7. Copy of sent note included in ticket.
kevin_eng: final status: all 7 imports completed by 03:48 UTC. Verified indices healthy and no duplicates. Internal logs: https://intra.redwood/logs/INC-2026-345 
maria_cs: next steps: 1) cs thread to track who booked enablement and who got credits (lara + tom). 2) eng to add a unit + integration test for optional metadata.field_x (kevin). 3) postmortem draft due EOD, share with account execs.
lara_se: adding follow-ups to the ticket and RSVPs to the office hours list.
kevin_eng: taking CI/test ownership. Will add automated rollback guard for schema changes.
tom_cust: ill notify renewals for the three accounts with near-term renewals and offer an extended trial if uptake risk appears.
maria_cs: thanks everyone. Good catch and quick turnaround. :clap:
